violations.text: Hollandaise sauce, rice, and mashed potatoes were observed held at temperatures ranging from 108-121 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items had been loaded into hot-hold unit less than 2 hours prior to the time of the inspection and was reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Raw shrimp was observed thawing on the counter in stagnant water. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Food items were placed into the prep sink and water was turned on. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the bar dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Call for service was placed during the time of inspection. Establishment is to sanitize all dishes and utensils in the sanitizing basin of the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled with the common name of the chemical or solution during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Establishment was observed vacuum sealing and placing seafood items (poached octopus) under sous vide during the time of inspection without prior approval through the submission of a HACCP plan or variance request. Per PIC, establishment has also used sous vide process for other raw animal proteins. Establishment is to cease process and practice of using sous vide as a method of cooking until proper approval has been provided. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Establishment was observed with seafood stuffing in the walk-in freezer that was placed in reduced oxygen packaging. Establishment does not have an approved HACCP plan for reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) of seafood items. Establishment is to cease practice of placing food items into ROP packing. Establishment is to work with food safety consultant to submit and receive approval for proposed HACCP plan for ROP packaging of seafood items and other raw animal proteins. Food items were embargoed during the time of inspection for further study. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back hallway leading to basement storage area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The hand sinks in the following areas need signage indicating when and where employees shall wash their hands: cookline by prep unit #2, first and second floor bar areas, and prep kitchen on second floor. New Violation. Correct By: 01/28/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on cookline prep unit #1 and the 2-door reach-in refrigerator. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the bar dishwasher. PIC acquired test strips from a neighboring restaurant during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine in the kitchen. PIC acquired thermo labels from neighboring restaurant during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 01/14/2026
